title: Stable Transfection of Corallochytrium limacisporum Using Lonza Nucleofector
author: Aleksandra Kozyczkowska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpfgmjjw

steps.title: Culture C. limacisporum
steps.instruction: Inoculate 100 μl of C. limacisporum culture into 5 ml of Marine Broth in a 25 cm 2 flask and incubate at 23°C in an air incubator for two days.

steps.title: Prepare and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Gently scrape the cells and use a hemocytometer to count them, ensuring a concentration of 1.5E6 cells per condition.

substeps.instruction: If multiple conditions are used, pull cells together to obtain a more visible pellet

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells and wash the pellet to remove impurities.

substeps.instruction: Spin down cells at 1500xg for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant
Wash the pellet with 100 μl of ice-cold 1XPBS per condition
Spin down again and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Prepare DNA Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the plasmid mixture using a highly concentrated (2-5 μg/ul) solution to avoid buffer dilution.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 μg of reporter plasmid (containing mCherry and puromycin resistance gene 'pac' under actin or tubulin promoter) with 20 μg of carrier DNA (pUC19)
Note: While 10 μg of reporter plasmid provides highest efficiency, 1 μg or 5 μg can also be successful
Transfer the DNA mix into 20 μl of ice-cold P3 buffer

steps.title: Combine Cells and DNA
steps.instruction: Add the DNA mix to the cell pellet and transfer the resulting mixture into a manufacturer kit strip.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the transfer is done carefully to avoid creating bubbles
Ensure the final volume is 20-25 μl

steps.title: Perform Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Insert the strip into the Lonza nucleofection system and apply program code EN-138.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Recovery
steps.instruction: Immediately recover the cells after transfection.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 μl of Marine Broth (MB) medium to the well and mix up and down
Transfer cells to a 12-well plate (NUNC) containing 1 ml of growth medium (MB) and incubate overnight

steps.title: Screen and Select Transfectants
steps.instruction: Verify transfection efficiency and apply antibiotic selection.

substeps.instruction: Check for positive cells using fluorescent microscopy 24-48 hours post-transfection
Replace 500 μl of medium with fresh MB containing 300 μg/ml of puromycin
